messages:
sam: Quick flag 11:12 UTC			Spotted intermittent 502s hitting /api/generate in prod-eu. Root cause looks like header-parsing edge-case on certain long prompt inputs. I have a tiny guardrail patch (6f3a2b4) that normalizes header parsing. Low-risk, no DB schema changes. Requesting expedited deploy in tonight's 00:30-01:00 UTC window.

deploybot: Deploy request queued for redwood/api:hotfix-6f3a2b4. Canary plan: 10% traffic 5m -> 50% 3m -> 100% if healthy. Please ACK with +1 (owners/oncall). Release owner: maria.

olivia (eng-oncall): +1. Ran quick staging-e2e against the hotfix image; sample smoke: ```curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' | jq .status``` -> 200. No token-encoding warnings in logs.

maria (release-manager): +1. Locking change window 00:30-01:00 UTC. Noting that the risk is limited to header parsing; rollout is reversible. Prep rollback cmds below and add final release note before promote.

tony (sre): Ready to rollback. Two options depending on situation. Fast revert (image swap) or rollout undo to a prior revision. I'll standby with cluster access.

Rollback (fast revert):
```bash
kubectl set image deployment/api api=redwood/api:main -n prod-eu && kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n prod-eu
```

Rollback (undo to rev):
```bash
kubectl rollout undo deployment/api -n prod-eu --to-revision=42
```

jen (qa): Staging smoke passed. I'll monitor 5xx rate, p50/p95 latency, and encoder errors post-canary. Draft release note at: https://docs.internal/redwood/release-notes/6f3a2b4-draft

deploybot: Deploy scheduled 00:32 UTC. Canary started at 00:33 UTC (10% traffic). Metrics: https://console.redwood/metrics/prod-eu?job=canary.

sam: Canary heartbeat: no increase in 5xx over baseline, KV hitrate stable, CPU/memory normal. Traces not showing header exceptions.

olivia: +1 to continue to 50% at 00:39 if still clean. :thumbsup:

maria: Hold until 00:44 to observe long-lived sessions for KV cache ripple. If everything green at 00:44, promote to full.

sam: Monitoring logs and distributed traces. Noted one slow request but not 5xx. tagging @tony for infra knobs.

deploybot: Promoting to 50% at 00:40 UTC... promotion successful.

tony: Temporarily adjusted rate-limit thresholds downward for the endpoint to smooth traffic during rollout. Watching ingress qlen and pod restart counts.

jen: 50% smoke passed. No spike in errors. Preparing post-promote smoke.

maria: Proceed to 100% at 00:44 if no new signals.

deploybot: Promoting to 100% traffic at 00:44 UTC... promotion complete. All pods updated. 705 

tony: Dashboards green. No pod restarts, request latencies within SLO.

jen: Final smoke: passed. Finalized release note: "Hotfix 6f3a2b4: fix header-parsing causing intermittent 502s in EU region." Published: https://docs.internal/redwood/release-notes/6f3a2b4

maria: Signed off and closing the hotfix window. If anything emerges, use rollback commands above and ping #eng-oncall. Thanks all for the quick turnaround. :party_parrot:

sam: Thanks team, nice quickhand.
